scope: TRAIN-only exploratory tracking comparison; TEST remains closed; V4 unchanged
hypothesis: Se a associação começar na proposta de maior confiança do início do clipe e depois priorizar proximidade à trajetória extrapolada, recusando saltos distantes, ela reduzirá trocas bruscas para objetos de fundo sem perda inaceitável de identidade/continuidade.
baseline: Existing Viterbi selected path from the exact frozen detector candidate lists.
candidate_source: ORACLE-TRACKER-RETEST-EXP-0001 frozen prediction-only Top-10 boxes; no new detector inference.

algorithm.seed_policy: within the first five frames, choose the highest-confidence candidate; break ties by earlier frame, then candidate rank
algorithm.motion_model: constant-velocity extrapolation from the last two accepted candidate centers; hold the last center before a second observation
algorithm.association: select the candidate nearest the predicted trajectory point; confidence is only a deterministic tie-breaker
algorithm.no_candidate_inside_gate: emit a track gap; never jump to a farther candidate; do not reacquire after the maximum gap
algorithm.confidence_after_seed: not allowed to override trajectory distance

evaluation.primary: For full 41-frame runs, compare Viterbi and anchored tracking on frames 16-26 using visible/partial manual ball boxes, candidate recall, identity accuracy, distractor switches, selected-box coverage and normalized jumps.
evaluation.secondary: Report full-window gaps/continuity and the central-window-start sensitivity separately.
evaluation.stratification: per match and event role; preserve positive/control identities
evaluation.promotion: No promotion from this post-hoc TRAIN experiment. Any threshold or model selection requires a separately frozen match-level development protocol.

limits: The seed can itself be a false positive.
A fixed image-plane speed gate can reject real fast motion or camera pans.
The experiment tests trajectory association only; it does not train or change the BALL detector.
Projected image-plane continuity is not physical 3D ball motion.
